name: inventory_adjustment_permissions
preconditionSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.schema_migrations WHERE version = '0025') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.permissions WHERE permission_key IN ('inventory.allow_negative_stock','inventory.set_adjustment_cost')) AS ok;
verificationSql: SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.permissions WHERE permission_key IN ('inventory.allow_negative_stock','inventory.set_adjustment_cost') AND module='inventory') = 2 AS ok;
recovery: Transactional failure rolls back the permission-catalog migration. After successful apply, preserve the stable permission keys and use forward-only correction.
